description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

The Demand Generation team brings Tailscale to the people who need it, wherever they already spend their time. For many technical folks, that's a favorite YouTube channel, podcast, newsletter, or stream. As our Demand Gen Coordinator, you'll help us show up in those places in a way that feels genuine and earns trust.

You'll find creators and outlets who share our values, build real relationships with them, and guide partnerships from first hello to final deliverable. Along the way, you'll write briefs, review content, keep projects on track, and help us learn what actually works. This role is a great fit for someone early in their career who loves both technology and the people who make content about it, and who wants room to grow.

Key Responsibilities

Creator Research & Discovery

  • Research and identify creators across YouTube, podcasts, newsletters, streaming, and social media who cover self-hosting, networking, security, and developer tools.
  • Evaluate creators on audience fit, content quality, technical accuracy, values alignment, and brand safety.
  • Build and maintain a creator pipeline that tracks prospects, past partners, and performance history.

Outreach & Relationship Management

  • Own outreach to new creators and act as their day-to-day point of contact.
  • Maintain strong, long-term relationships across partnerships that often span one to two quarters with multiple deliverables.
  • Partner with your manager on proposals, negotiations, and budget by preparing recommendations on rates, deliverables, and timelines.

Contracts & Partnership Operations

  • Navigate internal processes for contracts, legal review, vendor setup, and payments in partnership with Legal and Finance.
  • Track deliverables, deadlines, payments, and usage rights across all active partnerships.
  • Keep internal stakeholders informed on partnership status, upcoming content, and blockers.

Briefs, Content Review & Facilitation

  • Write clear creative briefs that turn product launches, features, and key messages into guidance creators can run with.
  • Review content drafts for technical accuracy, messaging, brand guidelines, and disclosure requirements.
  • Facilitate feedback between creators and internal teams, including Product Marketing, Developer Relations, Engineering, and Legal, when needed.
  • QA tracking links, UTMs, and promo codes before content goes live.

Performance & Reporting

  • Track and report on partnership performance, including reach, engagement, signups, and pipeline influence.
  • Share learnings and recommend where to invest next based on what's working.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with Community Programs, Developer Relations, Social, and Lifecycle Marketing to amplify creator content and connect creators with launches, events, and campaigns.

What We Are Looking For

  • 1-3 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, sponsorships, partner marketing, demand generation, or adjacent fields.
  • Hands-on technical experience, such as running a homelab, self-hosting services, or tinkering with networking, so you can follow technical content and spot inaccuracies.
  • Experience reaching out to and building relationships with external partners, creators, or vendors.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to write briefs that are clear, concise, and easy to act on.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a quality-assurance mindset; you catch broken links, missing tracking, or off-brand messaging before anything ships.
  • Ability to manage several partnerships at once with high reliability and end-to-end ownership.
  • Comfortable collaborating across Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Product to move multi-stakeholder projects forward.
  • Experience using LLMs and AI tools to speed up research and routine operational work.
  • Genuine curiosity about the people who create technical content and the communities that watch, read, and listen.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a developer-focused, infrastructure, security, or B2B SaaS company.
  • Active presence in technical communities such as r/homelab, r/selfhosted, Discord servers, or similar.
  • An existing network of technical creators or familiarity with the technical creator landscape.
  • Experience with influencer discovery tools or creator databases.
  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, or Jira.
  • Familiarity with FTC disclosure guidelines and content usage rights.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally to support events and creator meetups.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range
$76,000—$92,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. 
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! 
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. 
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness.
